scope: Bounded engineering verification of existing adapters, not a scientific run or whole-machine acceptance.
verified_in_dom_doubles: M3 step updates the shared Stack source cursor and Binder sample; separate running flags remain explicit.
Live Pascal follows accepted receipts; explicit capture becomes HELD and does not move on later receipts; explicit follow resumes current input.
Missing live source clears current Pascal data to HOLD; rendering cannot resurrect stale live input.
Ihara accepted turn commits; immediate reverse is BLOCK and retains the current directed edge.
Binder mount/reconnect adds no timer, playback command or source step.

browser_acceptance.reason: Local file browser access was previously policy-denied; no alternate transport or access workaround used.
manual_checks: Reload Bench; use available-contract reconnect if needed. Step M3 once: Stack source index and Binder sample must agree.
In the bound Club monitor, observe live Pascal, capture input, then change Player input: held word must stay fixed. Re-enable follow: current word must return.
Commit Ihara C or D, note edge, then request reverse: BLOCK must appear without changing that edge.
